correctness.rationale: For Petersen KG(5,2), its 15 graph edges partition canonically into five three-element classes indexed by the missing element of the two disjoint 2-subsets. Independent breadth-first all-pairs distances on the line graph confirm each within-class distinct pair at distance 3 and every interclass pair at distance ≤2 (counts 30 distance1,60 distance2,15 distance3). Thus inclusive VR radius2 is literally the join of five discrete tripletons, with 4^5−1=1023 nonempty simplices and integral H4=(Z²)^⊗5 of rank32. The induced S5 action includes sign of permuting five join factors. Independent exhaustive 120-permutation signed simplicial Lefschetz characters equal the claimed (32,0,8,2,0,0,2) by cycle type; the Specht decomposition follows from S5 character inner products. Independently constructed signed 32-dimensional integral adjacent-transposition matrices verify Coxeter relations, and their concatenated (R_i−I) 32x128 integer matrix has Smith 30 units and two zero rows, proving torsion-free coinvariants Z². No claim of integral quotient-space homology.

The assessed original mathematical content is the full Koszul-signed integral S5 lattice, explicit seven-class character/Specht multiplicities, and no-torsion coinvariant Z². Adamaszek covers ordinary line-graph clique topology, not the radius-two 15-vertex S5 integral invariants. Resultary published Petersen particle-configuration S5 modules and graph three-cut module concern different complexes. Full primary color-theorem material inspected, no explicit homology lattice/Smith classification there; unindexed equivalent representation computation remains risk.
